title: Apply for the NSW Medical Energy Rebate (on supply customers)
summary: Find out how to apply for the NSW Medical Energy Rebate if you are an on-supply (embedded network) customer.
intro:
The NSW Medical Energy Rebate helps eligible concession cardholders pay their electricity bills. It is for people who are not able to, or have someone living with them who is not able to, self-regulate their body temperature in extreme environmental temperatures (hot or cold).

For on-supply customers, the NSW Medical Energy Rebate is $313.50 per embedded network household, per financial year.

If you are an embedded network (on supply) customer, you can apply for the rebate here.

If you are a retail (on-market) customer, contact your electricity retailer to apply.

Note: Embedded network (on-supply) means your electricity is supplied by an embedded network – such as in a residential community, retirement village or strata scheme – and you receive your electricity bill or invoice from the strata manager or community/village operator. If you’re not sure whether you're an on-supply customer, contact the electricity provider named on your electricity bill.
who_can_apply: You have an electricity account for your home in NSW.
You are the account holder (the account and bill must be in your name).

You hold one of the following cards: ARC Energy Group, Energy Locals / Energy locals Urban, Origin Energy (including most of their WINConnect sites), or Locality Planning Energy (LPE) at specific sites.
You or someone living with you are unable to self-regulate body temperature in extreme environmental temperatures (hot or cold).
what_you_need: The completed NSW Medical Energy Rebate Medical Declaration form (Attachment A).
A registered medical practitioner who can provide an assessment.
A printed copy (JPG or PDF) of your latest electricity bill or invoice, which must include your bank account details.

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the 'applicant' and 'patient' section in the NSW Medical Energy Rebate: Medical Declaration – PDF.
Ask your medical practitioner (GP or specialist) to complete the relevant sections of the form.
Follow the prompts to apply for the rebate.
Download and complete the NSW Medical Energy Rebate Application Form On-Supply Household – PDF.
Ask your medical practitioner to complete the medical declaration section.
Attach a copy of your most recent electricity bill or invoice.
Post your application to NSW Medical Energy Rebate, PO Box 435, Parramatta NSW 2124

more_info.text: If you've been treated by different doctors from the Royal Flying Doctor Service (RFDS) for at least 3 months, you may still be eligible for the rebate.
Embedded network customers will receive the rebate as a lump sum payment of $313.50 deposited into their bank account.
You can only receive the rebate for your principal place of residence.
A household can only receive one NSW Medical Energy Rebate each financial year.
If you receive the NSW Medical Energy Rebate, you may be eligible for the NSW Low Income Household Rebate or the NSW Gas Rebate.
Commonwealth Seniors Health Card holders are not eligible for this rebate and can apply for the Seniors Energy Rebate instead.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for the NSW Medical Energy Rebate?
faqs.a: You may be eligible if you live in NSW and meet specific criteria, including having an electricity account in your name and holding certain concession cards.

faqs.q: What is an on-supply (embedded network) customer?
faqs.a: An on-supply customer receives electricity from an embedded network, such as in a residential community, retirement village, or strata scheme, and receives their bill from the strata manager or community/village operator.

faqs.q: How much is the rebate for on-supply customers?
faqs.a: For on-supply customers, the rebate is $313.50 per embedded network household, per financial year.
